STAFF PHOTO BY HILARY SCHEINUK Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save Justin Mitchell Author email Follow Justin Mitchell The yellow-wearing, booty-shaking, Taylor Swift-loving Savannah Bananas will bring their moves to New Orleans next year with a pair of baseball games at the Caesars Superdome. The team announced their 2026 trip in a Facebook post Wednesday night. And they just might find luck or a kiss from the Irish, as they will host games on St. Patrick's Day weekend, March 14-15. If you want to see a New Orleans game, you have until Halloween to enter the ticket lottery for a chance to attend. The Bananas are a wildly popular baseball team focused on entertainment. Their version of baseball, called Banana Ball, focuses more on fans rather than the score and is fun for the entire family. Teammates often go viral on social media for their synchronized choreography, Taylor Swift karaoke and athletically hilarious matchups. The team tours around the U.S. and often sells out stadiums. Banana Ball came to Baton Rouge last year.
